ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixel distribution as mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-intensity pixel clusters are located at the central peduncle insertion point, transitioning to diffuse speckling in the medial regions of both lobes, with more solid low-intensity regions toward the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 55 degrees; depth is significant, clearly dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude serrations are visible along the entire trailing edge; a higher frequency of pixel variations is observed on the left lobe's inner margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit an upward sweep with a gentle convex curve along the trailing edge leading to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white clusters are visible, concentrated primarily in the central lower region and sporadically along the trailing margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct linear high-intensity mark is visible on the left lobe, oriented at a roughly 45-degree angle toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable diagonal linear scar on the mid-left lobe and multiple circular barnacle-related scars near the notch and central base.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt and pepper' pixel texture concentrated at the base of the fluke where it meets the water line.
